question: List the id and full name of each client in my scope, with the name of their agency.
reply:
```sql
SELECT c.client_id, c.full_name, a.name AS agency_name
FROM people.client AS c
JOIN org.agency AS a ON a.agency_id = c.agency_id
WHERE c.agency_id IN (:tenant_agency_ids)
ORDER BY c.client_id
```
